original day_maintain/day, week_maintain/week, month_maintain/month columns retained

invalid/past/future dates, unknown and SQL-like action names rejected

invalid month, broken schema/tag, corrupt database and unmarked existing file rejected without overwriting source bytes
invalid completion flag emits error and no partial loaded signal; corrected data loads again
initialization under EXCLUSIVE lock fails; same tagged empty DB initializes and saves after unlocking

resource budget, same-board realtime interference and long-duration validation
